newsitem.title: POLAND: WOLCZANKA PICKS BANK PEKAO TO MANAGE CASH.
newsitem.headline: WOLCZANKA PICKS BANK PEKAO TO MANAGE CASH.

text.p: Polish garment maker Wolczanka SA has picked state-owned commercial bank Bank Pekao SA to manage its cash surplus of about two million zlotys, the company's president said on Wednesday.
Ryszard Polanski told Reuters that a formal agreement with Pekao would be signed on November 21.
"On November 21 we will sign an agreement on managing Wolczanka's surplus cash. The institution which we chose is Bank Pekao SA," Polanski said.
He declined to give details on where the company wanted its cash invested.
Late last month Polanski said Wolczanka sought to place between 20 and 30 percent of its surplus -- about two million zlotys -- on the capital market.
The company expects a net profit of about six million zlotys this year against 6.5 million in 1995.
